inspected_frames.observation: All body units, narrow collum, trilobed plates and many exposed legs form a coherent juvenile reconstruction. Paired club eyes and both articulated antennae remain distinct.
Posterior telson region and serial lateral plates remain separate; no body core breaking through dorsal plates. Opposite-side leg row is visible.
Flattened head, two exposed stalked club eyes and lateral trilobed plate overhang are distinct; anterior legs and antennae are attached, not floating.
Whole body fits the frame. Low head, regular plate sequence and complete leg row are visible; eight leg regions require the supplementary actual-subject detail, not this reduced silhouette.
Terminal region and bilateral leg rows remain visible under the arched plates. Apparent overlap is expected perspective, not claimed proof of pair count.
Whole uncropped outline shows wingless collum followed by lateral plate flanges and separate terminal region. Both antenna outlines have discrete bulb and neck regions.
Color-independent faceting preserves three-lobed plate form, dorsal tubercles and seven-bulge antenna silhouette.
No floating islands or clipped extremities apparent. Broad trilobed body outline, club eyes and articulated antenna tips are identifiable.
